description: <p>Airlines across Europe received a series of bomb threats on Thursday morning for the second time this week, forcing many to make unplanned or escorted landings, although none of the threats immediately proved to be genuine.</p> <p>While no country has attributed blame for the threats, they come at a time when European officials have been blaming both Russia and Iran for what they describe as “hybrid attacks”. headline: PTA dismisses 'fake and misleading' notification claiming TikTok banned in Pakistan

headline: France braces for demonstrations as trade unions strike
description: <p>Hundreds of thousands of people are expected to take to the streets across France on Thursday, as unions hold strikes alongside student-led demonstrations that have gripped the country for weeks.</p> <p>The high school student movement that began with youth protesting dismal learning conditions has coincided with widespread anger over the rising cost of living and inequality, which culminated on October 17 in the worst rioting France has seen in years.</p> <p>On Thursday, authorities estimate some 500,000 to 700,000 people will protest across the country, while

description: <p>EACH winter, millions of working-class households across the country face the same ordeal.
